name: Can I paint over a mildew smell?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint over a mildew smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, painting over a mildew smell is not a permanent solution and is generally not recommended. The odor is caused by mold or mildew spores and their volatile organic compounds. Simply painting over them will mask the smell temporarily, but the underlying moisture problem and mold growth will persist. The mold will eventually grow through the new paint, and the smell will return. Before painting, it's crucial to identify and eliminate the source of moisture, thoroughly clean and remediate any mold, and ensure the area is completely dry. Only then should you consider repainting.
